record.question: What is the goal of antiviral therapy in chronic Hepatitis B infection?
record.explanation: Answer D: Both (b) and (c). Chronic HBV antivirals aim to suppress HBV replication to reduce progression to cirrhosis, liver failure, and liver cancer; eradication is not the usual achievable goal of current nucleos(t)ide analogue therapy. Reference: https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/Hepatitis-b; https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK614981/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
